headline: Gold eases ₹218 per gram today; silver flat at ₹2,00,000 per kg
summary: Today's 24k gold moved down ₹218 per gram (about 1.54%) to ₹13,980, while silver held unchanged at ₹2,00,000 per kg. Over the last week, gold fell about 4.26% from ₹14,602 on 5 November, and silver fell about 4.76% over the same stretch; over the full 18 days of data, silver is down about 9.09% from ₹2,20,000. Likely drivers include movements in international prices, the US dollar against the rupee, and seasonal demand, though the data does not confirm which factor dominated.
outlook: Prices have softened over the past week, so buyers not in a hurry may compare rates across jewellers before purchasing, keeping in mind that making charges and GST are added on top of these rates.
